request.recipient: TxPipe via Intersect treasury withdrawal administration
request.what: Fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Dolos maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The motivation text states the underlying grant is 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Dolos maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides efficient access to chain data without the overhead of traditional full nodes.

The document says Dolos connects directly to the Cardano network, indexes ledger primitives, and exposes five query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C Unix socket compatible with existing tooling.
The document reports Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors, with a GitHub repository link provided for verification.
The proposal states Dolos is fully open source and welcomes broader developer community contributions.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The document states the requested amount does not, at submission time alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

The document states Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multi-party authorization rules, oversight committee checks, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

The document states TxPipe has received 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development on schedule, and that prior Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC is being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month Dolos maintenance program administered by Intersect, with claims centered on Dolos as open-source lightweight Cardano infrastructure, prior development/adoption signals, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based oversight.
